inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: First Aid kit in vehicle was missing thermometer.  First Aide kit in daycare missing first aid guide.  NOTE: Director restocked the first aid kits appropriately during visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Electronic Safety Alarm did not function at the time of the inspection and could not be properly demonstrated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There was grass growing in the loosefill mulch in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguisher had not been service in the transport vehicle since 9/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: There were two booster seats in the transport that have been expired since 2015.  NOTE: These were removed during visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: Operation did not have a current grounds and maintenance checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: Personel files were not available during the unannnouced monitoring inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Director has failed to ensure that staff has maintained proper Health and Safety trianing.  Records reviewed were missing current training in the following topics,  SIDS, abuse and neglect, Haz.Mat., Allergens.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two employees do not have face to face  training in CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two employees do not have face to face  training in CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Cribs were observed to have loose fitting sheets on mattresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: List of children with allergies was not observed to be posted in kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Child with a diagnosed food allergy (beef) did not have a plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: Standing water was observed in outdoor play area, within overturned play structures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap: The use zone for the toddler play structure was overlapping the use zone for the older children play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4805(d))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: Directors employee file was not available for inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Director has failed to ensure that staff has maintained proper Health and Safety trianing.  Records reviewed were missing current training in the following topics, Building premises, SIDS, abuse and neglect, Haz.Mat., Allergens.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loosefill in outdoor play area not maintained, The underliner was showing in spots and grass was growing in the loosefill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The employee list has not been validated within the last 3 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 12 month old child was in the toddler room where the oldest child in the room was over 3 years old.    Note: The provider moved the 12 month old to the infant room during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: Children were observed sleeping with bottles during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation emailed an incident to Child Care Regulation and it was not called in to the local office until October 9th, 2023. Emails are not an acceptable method of reporting incidents to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization: Based upon the information obtained, the operation did not notify Child Care Regulation within the required timeframe for a child who had a seizure while in care and was taken to the hospital.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: Person left in charge by the director, did not have access to provide needed documentations for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 5 out of 6 children's records reviewed did not have an emergency contact information available besides parents. There was not a form available to review that stated the 5 out of 6 parents chose not to designate anyone else for emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outside fence along the route the children take to the playground was broken with sharp pieces of the fence sticking out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 2 out of 5 caregivers files reviewed did not have 24 hours of annual training for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone on the side of the green slide does not extend a minimum of 6 feet. It located right next to a black gate. An additional 5 feet is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver stated there were 15 children in care during the inspection. When counting the number of children in the classroom there were actually 17 children.    Note: Discussed with the provider at the inspection that all caregivers must know the number of children they are responsible for at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: A child's head was covered with a pillow in the toddler classroom during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the pillow at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: A trash can in the toddler room contained dirty diapers that were not sealed in a plastic bag or covered by any lid or top to the trash can.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the provider covered the trash with the lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2022 data from January 26, 2023 revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2022 by January 15, 2023 as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: During Inspection  activity plan  not available for review for each group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Sanation Inspection  was not avaiable for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe: During Inspection  Keeping Children Safe  poster not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §746.401(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: During Inspection   parent notification   poster  not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: During Inspection   evacuation and relocation diagram    poster not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers: During Inspection   required phone numbers    not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §746.401(8))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Fire inspection was not avaiable for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection bugs were observed through-out operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: During the inception the spaces for infants, toddles, Pre-k, and Schoolers did not have the required activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: During Inspection   current list of employees    not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

Pictures taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
